name: William F. Galvin
summary: William Francis Galvin (born September 17, 1950) is an American politician who has served as the 27th Massachusetts Secretary of the Commonwealth since 1995. A member of the Democratic Party, he previously served in the Massachusetts House of Representatives from 1975 to 1991.
